blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ national swine inventory declined to 8.94 million heads as of Sept. 30, falling 1.9 percent from 9.11 million heads a year earlier to reach its lowest level since 1995, according to data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
